conviction_note: Near-null. There is no IFIS or 四季報 consensus, the company gives no H1 guide, and Pasona has not revised its forecast at either of the last two Q1 prints. So the Q1 release is unlikely to add a forecast change or a return. The three findings are small, mostly computable from the last 短信, and add up to -0.25. abs_move is 2.4, the median reaction on the true 15:30 release dates (the baseline's 4.04 rests on misdated windows), and p_up is 48. The scaled number therefore sits a little under the finding sum. Both numbers are deliberately small.
bar: Unsourced as a market bar. No analyst consensus exists (kabuyoho/IFIS shows consensus '--', rating '--': https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=2168). The only bars are the company FY2027/5 guide (revenue 325,000m +5.3%, OP 1,500m vs -1,149m, ordinary 1,500m, net -1,000m; no H1 guide), from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260604562997.pdf, and the prior-year Q1 (revenue 76,965m, OP -568m, ordinary -64m, net -606m), from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251015/140120251002567388.pdf. print_vs_bar is revenue against a straight-line pace of the FY revenue guide (~81bn). Every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-14 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio 信用倍率 8.03, a crowded retail margin long, also shown on kabutan 2026-10-15 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2168). No options, so no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.204, run-up 20d -4.96%, 5d -0.82%. Nikkei was -3.7% intraday on 2026-10-15 before the release; that is market-wide and sits before the entry close.

findings.finding: Q1 FY26 ordinary income (-64m) carried 358m of one-off Expo non-operating items: 協賛金収入 225m and 万博物販収入 260m, less 万博物販原価 127m. Its net carried a 520m extraordinary Expo cost. Neither recurs in Q1 FY27, so the kabutan/retail headline metric (経常) is mechanically set up to read 'Q1 ordinary loss widened' even if operating loss improves.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 prints moved small. 2024-10-15 (Q1 ordinary -479m) +1.56% and 2025-10-15 (Q1 ordinary -64m, Expo-boosted) -0.44%, measured close to next close from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2168.T?range=3y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The Expo items are disclosed and the FY guide sets ordinary equal to OP, so careful holders know. The holder base is retail and margin-long (信用倍率 8.03), and kabutan's automated headline ranks prints on 経常 YoY, so a mechanical 'widened loss' headline can still meet sellers. If it were fully priced, the margin long book would already have been cut.
findings.independence: Same company document family as the FY26 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260604562997.pdf), which shows FY totals 協賛金収入 542m and 万博物販収入 540m. One fact, counted once.

findings.finding: The 地方創生・観光 segment loses its Q1 comp. Last summer's Nijigen no Mori was driven by the time-limited 鬼滅の刃 event (2025-03-15 to 2025-12-14), and summer 2026 carried only splash events at the existing attractions. The new Awaji retreat that opened in June 2026 adds start-up costs in this quarter. The segment's Q1 FY26 loss was -336m, so the loss likely widens YoY. This sits inside a FY guide that already plans this segment at -1,500m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No isolated reaction on this segment found. The 2026-06-25 forecast cut, which cited this segment's game business among three causes, was followed by -4.52%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The event end date and the retreat costs are in the FY 短信, and the guide plans the segment flat at -1.5bn. What is not visible is the quarterly phasing. A materially wider Q1 segment loss would read against a guide that needs +2.65bn of OP improvement.
findings.independence: Summer 2026 programme was splash events only, no new attraction (https://www.haveagood-holiday.com/en/articles/nijigen-no-mori-summer-splash-2026, snippet_only).

findings.finding: Japanese staffing demand stayed healthy into mid-2026. Peer Persol HD's Apr-Jun 2026 quarter (reported 2026-08-07, after Pasona's last print) showed revenue 424.0bn and operating income 18.9bn, against 373.7bn and 15.4bn a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on file. Pasona's revenue ran flat to down (-1.6% YoY in Mar-May 2026) while peers grew, so the read-through has not transmitted before.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a proxy. A different quarter (Apr-Jun) and a peer whose growth partly reflects its own acquisitions. Pasona's weakness in 人材紹介 and BPO peak-out is company-specific, so it transmits weakly.

outside_window.finding: On 2026-10-07 JPX named Pasona a TOPIX 移行措置銘柄 under the new TOPIX rules. Its weight is cut in eight quarterly steps, ending in exclusion at end-July 2028 unless it meets the criteria at the October 2027 re-evaluation. The passive selling lands on the step dates, not on this print.

Mercury AIFLNP's 2026 AGM proposal (buy back the founder family's 18.26m shares) lapses if the board adopts a family-governance policy within three months of the 2026-08-28 AGM. Any such policy disclosure would most likely come by ~2026-11-28, not with this Q1.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely at Q1. No revision at the 2024-10 or 2025-10 Q1 prints, although the company cut every year from FY24 to FY26 (FY26 cut on 04-14 and 06-25), always later in the year. Returns: none expected (year-end dividend only, buyback last done at a Q2). New-year guide: not applicable. Quarter: Q1 is seasonally loss-making (OP -436m FY25, -568m FY26), so 進捗率 against a +1,500m FY OP plan is meaningless at Q1. Read it as OP improvement YoY against the +2.65bn FY improvement the guide needs.
baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, as do the margin overhang (lean -0.2) and the soft 20d tape. All of them are computable from public documents. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY guide with Q1 OP improving YoY, plus 悪材料出尽くし on a stock down ~30% YoY at PBR 0.43 with an activist on the register; a buyback would also be positive. I looked for any buyback, return or governance signal and found none, so p_up stays close to 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on data computable from the last 短信): the Expo-comp finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2 and the Nijigen/retreat finding from -0.2 to -0.15, because both are visible in public documents. p_up moved from 47 to 48.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive the release could carry is now written in baseline_tension, and I looked for it (buyback, returns, governance). Finding none, the Persol proxy stays at +0.1. No new positive was invented.
